text:
maria: Quick sync 1 want to land a new compact permission badge in the invite drawer. Shows role shortname + info affordance. Figma: https://figma.com/file/perm-badge

josh: Nice. How does the info affordance behave for keyboard / SR?

lena: Proposed flow: tab to badge, Enter opens popover, Esc closes, focus returns to badge. Popover uses role=dialog with aria-label="permission details" and a close button first.

omar: Avoid trapping focus in the drawer. If dialog steals focus permanently the form flow breaks. Popover w/o trap is fine.

maria: Need interactive links inside (roles matrix, learn more) so role=tooltip won't work. We'll do popover with programmatic focus restore. Add visible focus outline and 44px hit area.

josh: Analytics: emit permission_help_open and learn_more_click. Also track mixed_summary_expand when multiple roles differ.

lena: A11y notes: badge contrast low at small size. Bump to >=3:1 for icon bg and 4.5:1 for text if small. SR should announce when expanded: "expanded list of invite recipients and roles". Add aria-expanded on control.

omar: Copy tweak: change "Can edit, view audit logs, and manage billing" to "Role capabilities shown; custom roles may differ. See role details." Also if org has SSO mapping, add "Role mapping may be controlled by SSO group rules" with link to org settings. Security will review wording.

design-bot: Checklist: keyboard nav, focus management, ARIA labels, contrast, hit targets, telemetry. Run a11y checklist after PR.

maria: I'll update Figma and open a small PR with a11y attrs and telemetry. ETA: EOD tomorrow. Assign reviews: frontend @josh, SSO copy @omar. :rocket:
